title: Federal public service recourse — curated case-law index
status: Curated, non-exhaustive collection of identified published decisions and official summaries; source portals provide broader searches
methodology: Includes every previously indexed case plus additional decisions drawn from official federal Board and CHRT annual reports or linked full decisions. Case status distinguishes successful, unsuccessful, mixed and procedural outcomes; a procedural ruling does not decide discrimination. Official annual report summaries are linked when a validated direct case URL is not available. Court appeals and later rulings may change outcomes. This finite case index is not an exhaustive census of every published decision and cannot include confidential settlements or unpublished complaints. A separate official-source directory links to searchable full decision collections. Historical statutory remedies and tribunal jurisdictions can differ from current law. Entries with direct court judgments are distinguishable from official summaries; confidential settlements and unpublished CHRC files are not included.

cases.title: British Columbia (Public Service Employee Relations Commission) v. BCGSEU
cases.what: An apparently neutral fitness standard had an adverse impact on women. The employer failed to justify the standard as reasonably necessary.
cases.what_fr: Une norme d’aptitude apparemment neutre désavantageait les femmes. L’employeur n’a pas justifié sa nécessité raisonnable.
cases.factors: Job-related purpose, good faith, genuine necessity, individual alternatives and undue hardship.
cases.factors_fr: Objectif lié au travail, bonne foi, nécessité réelle, solutions individuelles et contrainte excessive.
cases.outcome: The Court restored an arbitration award of reinstatement and lost wages and benefits.
cases.outcome_fr: La Cour a rétabli l’ordonnance de réintégration et l’indemnisation des salaires et avantages perdus.
cases.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

cases.title: Fraser v. Canada (Attorney General)
cases.what: A pension-credit rule for RCMP job-sharing members disproportionately disadvantaged women, engaging Charter equality rights.
cases.what_fr: Une règle sur les crédits de pension des membres de la GRC partageant un poste désavantageait les femmes de façon disproportionnée.
cases.factors: Disparate impact, contextual evidence and whether a rule perpetuates pre-existing disadvantage.
cases.factors_fr: Effet disproportionné, preuve contextuelle et perpétuation de désavantages préexistants.
cases.outcome: The appeal was allowed; the Court found the pension rule discriminatory, with entitlement implications for buyback credit.
cases.outcome_fr: L’appel a été accueilli; la règle de pension était discriminatoire, avec des conséquences sur les crédits rachetables.
cases.appliesTo: Federal public-sector or military context; confirm applicable employment statute

cases.title: Canadian National Railway Co. v. Canada (Human Rights Commission)
cases.what: A systemic pattern of excluding women from non-traditional jobs justified a special employment program.
cases.what_fr: Un schéma systémique d’exclusion des femmes de postes non traditionnels justifiait un programme spécial d’emploi.
cases.factors: Workforce patterns, barriers in recruitment and promotion, nature and scope of systemic discrimination and necessary corrective action.
cases.factors_fr: Répartition des emplois, obstacles au recrutement et à la promotion, discrimination systémique et mesures correctives nécessaires.
cases.outcome: The Court upheld authority for systemic remedial measures, not merely individual damages.
cases.outcome_fr: La Cour a confirmé le pouvoir d’imposer des mesures correctives systémiques, et non seulement des indemnités individuelles.
cases.appliesTo: Federally regulated employment outside the core public service

cases.title: Tibbs v. Deputy Minister of National Defence
cases.what: A staffing challenge clarified five broad categories of abuse of authority; the complainant did not prove abuse on the facts.
cases.what_fr: Une contestation de dotation a clarifié cinq catégories d’abus de pouvoir; la plaignante n’a pas démontré d’abus dans les faits.
cases.factors: Improper intention, inadequate evidence, improper result, legal error and unlawfully fettered discretion.
cases.factors_fr: Intention illégitime, preuve insuffisante, résultat irrégulier, erreur de droit et exercice entravé du pouvoir discrétionnaire.
cases.outcome: The complaint was dismissed. The categories help identify possible legal errors but are not proof by themselves.
cases.outcome_fr: La plainte a été rejetée. Les catégories aident à reconnaître les erreurs possibles, mais ne suffisent pas à les prouver.
cases.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case
cases.sourceNote: Dismissed claim concerns staffing, union representation, or retaliation; not a finding that underlying employer discrimination allegations were disproven.

cases.title: Canada (Attorney General) v. Johnstone
cases.what: A CBSA scheduling policy interfered with parental childcare obligations. The court upheld the family-status discrimination finding.
cases.what_fr: L’horaire de l’ASFC entravait les obligations parentales de garde d’enfants. La cour a confirmé la discrimination liée à la situation de famille.
cases.factors: Childcare legal responsibility, genuine need, available alternatives, non-trivial interference, and the employer’s accommodation response.
cases.factors_fr: Obligations légales de garde, besoin réel, solutions disponibles, entrave non négligeable et réponse de l’employeur.
cases.outcome: The court upheld the finding of family-status discrimination but varied some remedies, including how lost wages and employer-policy consultation were addressed.
cases.outcome_fr: La cour a confirmé la discrimination liée à la situation de famille, tout en modifiant certaines réparations, notamment les salaires perdus et la consultation sur la politique de l’employeur.
cases.appliesTo: Federal public-sector or military context; confirm applicable employment statute

cases.title: Sidhu & Kopeck v. International Longshore and Warehouse Union Local 500
cases.what: Union dispatch and pension-related rules disadvantaged older workers based on age.
cases.what_fr: Des règles syndicales liées à la répartition du travail et aux pensions désavantageaient les personnes plus âgées.
cases.factors: Effect of neutral policy on older workers, treatment of people receiving pensions, the prohibited ground of age.
cases.factors_fr: Effet d’une politique neutre sur les travailleurs âgés, traitement des pensionnés et motif protégé de l’âge.
cases.outcome: The Tribunal found age discrimination at the liability stage; a separate remedy stage was required. The decision was subject to a Federal Court judicial-review application (T-833-25). Check current status before relying on it.
cases.outcome_fr: Le Tribunal a conclu à la discrimination fondée sur l’âge quant à la responsabilité; les réparations nécessitaient une autre étape. La décision faisait l’objet d’une demande de contrôle judiciaire à la Cour fédérale (T-833-25). Vérifiez le statut actuel.
cases.appliesTo: Federally regulated employment outside the core public service

cases.title: Molyneaux v. National Arts Centre Corporation
cases.what: The employee alleged a failure to accommodate disabilities; the Tribunal found that the employer had provided reasonable solutions.
cases.what_fr: L’employé alléguait un refus d’adaptation lié à un handicap; le Tribunal a constaté des solutions raisonnables offertes par l’employeur.
cases.factors: Adverse effect, connection to disability, substance of accommodation requests and reasonableness of employer responses.
cases.factors_fr: Effet préjudiciable, lien avec le handicap, demandes d’adaptation et caractère raisonnable des réponses.
cases.outcome: The complaint was dismissed. A disability alone does not automatically prove an adverse impact or a failure to accommodate.
cases.outcome_fr: La plainte a été rejetée. Un handicap ne prouve pas à lui seul un effet défavorable ou un manquement à l’obligation d’adaptation.
cases.appliesTo: Federal public-sector or military context; confirm applicable employment statute

cases.title: Canada (Minister of Citizenship and Immigration) v. Vavilov
cases.what: A leading administrative-law case about how courts review reasonableness of decisions and reasons. It was not an employment complaint.
cases.what_fr: Arrêt majeur sur le contrôle judiciaire de la raisonnabilité et des motifs. Il ne s’agissait pas d’une plainte d’emploi.
cases.factors: Rational and coherent reasons, legal and factual constraints, justification in light of the record and decision-making context.
cases.factors_fr: Motifs rationnels et cohérents, contraintes juridiques et factuelles, justification selon le dossier et le contexte.
cases.outcome: The decision under review was set aside; the case established the modern reasonableness framework.
cases.outcome_fr: La décision contrôlée a été annulée; l’arrêt a établi le cadre moderne de la raisonnabilité.
cases.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

cases.title: Dorais v. Canadian Armed Forces
cases.what: The Canadian Armed Forces rejected an applicant for re-enrolment as a nurse based on an inadequate individual medical assessment. The Tribunal found disability discrimination even though the medical standard itself was not discriminatory.
cases.what_fr: Les Forces armées canadiennes ont refusé la réinscription d’un candidat infirmier après une évaluation médicale individuelle insuffisante. Le Tribunal a constaté une discrimination liée au handicap, bien que la norme médicale ne soit pas elle-même discriminatoire.
cases.factors: The evidence available to assess functional limitations, whether the applicant knew what medical proof was needed, individualized assessment and accommodation short of undue hardship.
cases.factors_fr: Les preuves nécessaires pour évaluer les limitations fonctionnelles, les renseignements médicaux demandés, l’évaluation individualisée et l’adaptation sans contrainte excessive.
cases.outcome: The Tribunal ordered $9,000 for pain and suffering and $4,000 as special compensation. This is a real monetary award, not a standard entitlement.
cases.outcome_fr: Le Tribunal a accordé 9 000 $ pour préjudice moral et 4 000 $ en indemnité spéciale. Il s’agit d’une réparation propre au dossier, et non d’un droit automatique.
cases.appliesTo: Federal public-sector or military context; confirm applicable employment statute

cases.title: Kim v. Correctional Service Canada
cases.what: The complainant alleged retaliation due to previous human-rights complaints, based on a psychologist's risk report. The Tribunal found insufficient evidence that the psychologist knew of the earlier human-rights complaints.
cases.what_fr: Le plaignant alléguait des représailles liées à de précédentes plaintes en droits de la personne, en lien avec un rapport psychologique. Le Tribunal a constaté l’absence de preuve suffisante que le psychologue connaissait ces plaintes.
cases.factors: Actual or inferred knowledge of protected complaints, causal connection, access to records, competing explanations and evidence of retaliation.
cases.factors_fr: Connaissance réelle ou déduite des plaintes protégées, lien causal, accès au dossier, autres explications et preuves de représailles.
cases.outcome: The Tribunal dismissed the retaliation complaint. A judicial-review application was filed (Federal Court T-1964-25); check current status.
cases.outcome_fr: Le Tribunal a rejeté la plainte pour représailles. Une demande de contrôle judiciaire a été déposée (Cour fédérale T-1964-25); vérifiez le statut actuel.
cases.appliesTo: Not an employee dispute; useful only for a procedural or legal principle
cases.sourceNote: Dismissed claim concerns staffing, union representation, or retaliation; not a finding that underlying employer discrimination allegations were disproven.

cases.title: Abadi v. TST Overland Express
cases.what: Long-running workplace harassment related to actual or perceived race, origin and religion; a later termination involved disability discrimination.
cases.factors: The employer failed to answer repeated harassment or justify refusing short medical leave. Race and religion were not proven factors in the termination itself.
cases.outcome: Harassment and disability discrimination established; the Tribunal awarded lost wages, $17,000 for pain and suffering and $12,000 in special compensation, with further calculations and interest.
cases.what_fr: Le harcèlement prolongé était lié à la race, à l’origine ou à la religion réelles ou perçues; le licenciement impliquait une discrimination liée au handicap.
cases.factors_fr: L’employeur n’a pas répondu au harcèlement ni justifié le refus de congé médical. La race et la religion n’ont pas été établies comme facteurs du licenciement.
cases.outcome_fr: Harcèlement et discrimination liée au handicap établis; salaires perdus, 17 000 $ pour préjudice moral et 12 000 $ d’indemnité spéciale, avec calculs et intérêts.
cases.appliesTo: Federally regulated employment outside the core public service

cases.title: Johnson v. Membertou First Nation
cases.what: A manager alleged her race, colour or origin played a role in termination and that a discriminatory preference policy existed.
cases.factors: The Tribunal accepted performance and insubordination as the reasons for dismissal; evidence did not establish the alleged link to protected grounds or discriminatory policy.
cases.outcome: Race-related employment complaint dismissed.
cases.what_fr: Une gestionnaire alléguait un congédiement fondé sur la race, la couleur ou l’origine et une politique préférentielle discriminatoire.
cases.factors_fr: Le Tribunal a retenu le rendement et l’insubordination; aucun lien avec un motif protégé ni politique discriminatoire n’a été démontré.
cases.outcome_fr: Plainte de discrimination raciale en emploi rejetée.
cases.appliesTo: Federally regulated employment outside the core public service

cases.title: SM, SV and JR v. RCMP (later judicial review)
cases.body: Canadian Human Rights Tribunal / Federal Court
cases.what: Three South Asian RCMP members alleged discriminatory promotion decisions. The Tribunal initially dismissed their complaints.
cases.factors: The initial decision found insufficient evidence linking the decisions to race. The Federal Court subsequently set it aside and returned three complaints to the Tribunal.
cases.outcome: Not a final unsuccessful discrimination case: the Tribunal's 2025 report confirms the 2024 dismissals were set aside by 2025 FC 1893.
cases.what_fr: Trois membres sud-asiatiques de la GRC alléguent une discrimination dans les promotions; les plaintes avaient été initialement rejetées.
cases.factors_fr: Le Tribunal estimait le lien avec la race insuffisamment prouvé. La Cour fédérale a ensuite annulé sa décision et renvoyé les plaintes.
cases.outcome_fr: Le rejet de 2024 n’est pas définitif : le rapport 2025 confirme l’annulation par 2025 CF 1893.
cases.appliesTo: Federal public-sector or military context; confirm applicable employment statute

cases.title: Bedirian v. Treasury Board (Global Affairs Canada)
cases.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
cases.what: An employee challenged refusal of a religious exemption from the federal COVID-19 vaccination policy.
cases.factors: The Board found conscience-based objection insufficiently connected to religion, while other asserted religious grounds lacked consistent, persuasive evidence of sincere belief.
cases.outcome: Religious accommodation grievance dismissed.
cases.what_fr: Un employé conteste le refus d’une exemption religieuse à la politique fédérale de vaccination contre la COVID-19.
cases.factors_fr: Une objection de conscience n’était pas suffisamment liée à la religion; les autres motifs ne reposaient pas sur une preuve cohérente de croyances sincères.
cases.outcome_fr: Grief d’accommodement religieux rejeté.
cases.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

cases.title: Lemay v. Treasury Board (Public Safety)
cases.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
cases.what: An employee challenged the refusal of religious accommodation from the federal COVID-19 vaccination policy.
cases.factors: The Board accepted the sincerely held religious belief and found exclusion from work was a substantial interference. Remedies were reserved.
cases.outcome: Religious accommodation grievance allowed; remedy to be addressed separately.
cases.what_fr: Un employé conteste le refus d’un accommodement religieux à la politique fédérale de vaccination contre la COVID-19.
cases.factors_fr: La Commission a reconnu une croyance religieuse sincère et une atteinte importante découlant de l’exclusion du travail; la réparation a été réservée.
cases.outcome_fr: Grief d’accommodement religieux accueilli; réparation à examiner séparément.
cases.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

cases.title: Harkness v. Deputy Head (Correctional Service of Canada)
cases.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
cases.what: An employee contested a non-advertised appointment for abuse of authority, favouritism and alleged disability discrimination.
cases.factors: Missing records, procedural unfairness and deficient merit assessment established abuse of authority; the evidence did not establish discrimination or personal favouritism.
cases.outcome: Staffing complaint allowed and appointment revoked, but the discrimination allegation was not proven.
cases.what_fr: Une employée conteste une nomination non annoncée pour abus de pouvoir, favoritisme et discrimination alléguée fondée sur le handicap.
cases.factors_fr: Les dossiers incomplets et l’évaluation déficiente du mérite prouvent l’abus de pouvoir; la discrimination et le favoritisme ne sont pas démontrés.
cases.outcome_fr: Plainte de dotation accueillie et nomination révoquée, mais la discrimination n’est pas établie.
cases.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

cases.title: Kemp v. Public Service Alliance of Canada
cases.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
cases.what: A member alleged unfair union representation after the union withdrew support for an underlying disability-related grievance.
cases.factors: The Board found no arguable breach of the union's duty of fair representation. It did not decide whether the employer's alleged disability discrimination occurred.
cases.outcome: Unfair-representation complaint dismissed, without a ruling on the merits of the employer discrimination allegation.
cases.what_fr: Un membre allègue une représentation syndicale injuste après le retrait du soutien à un grief lié au handicap.
cases.factors_fr: La Commission n’a trouvé aucune violation défendable du devoir de représentation juste; elle n’a pas statué sur la discrimination alléguée par l’employeur.
cases.outcome_fr: Plainte de représentation rejetée, sans décision sur le fond de l’allégation contre l’employeur.
cases.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case
cases.sourceNote: Dismissed claim concerns staffing, union representation, or retaliation; not a finding that underlying employer discrimination allegations were disproven.

cases.title: Milinkovich v. Treasury Board (Transport Canada)
cases.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
cases.what: Employee challenged shift scheduling and denial of accommodation for childcare responsibilities.
cases.factors: The Board found no serious efforts to reconcile childcare conflicts and, applying an alternative legal test, no adverse employment-related impact.
cases.outcome: Family-status accommodation grievance dismissed.
cases.what_fr: Un employé conteste les horaires et le refus d’accommodement pour obligations de garde d’enfants.
cases.factors_fr: La Commission a constaté l’absence d’efforts sérieux de conciliation et, selon l’autre critère juridique, aucun effet préjudiciable lié à l’emploi.
cases.outcome_fr: Grief d’accommodement pour situation de famille rejeté.
cases.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

cases.title: Commission scolaire régionale de Chambly v. Bergevin
cases.what: Jewish teachers lost pay when observing Yom Kippur, unlike employees whose religious holidays matched the work calendar.
cases.factors: A neutral work calendar had a discriminatory effect; the collective agreement and past practice showed paid accommodation was feasible without undue hardship.
cases.outcome: The Supreme Court upheld the employees' entitlement to reasonable accommodation and pay for the religious observance.
cases.what_fr: Des enseignants juifs perdaient leur salaire à Yom Kippour, contrairement aux collègues dont les fêtes correspondaient au calendrier.
cases.factors_fr: Le calendrier neutre avait un effet discriminatoire; la convention et la pratique antérieure permettaient l’accommodement sans contrainte excessive.
cases.outcome_fr: La Cour suprême a confirmé le droit à un accommodement raisonnable et à la rémunération pour cette journée.
cases.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

cases.title: Ontario Human Rights Commission v. Simpsons-Sears Ltd. (O'Malley)
cases.what: A Seventh-day Adventist employee was moved from full-time to part-time work because she could not work Saturdays.
cases.factors: The Court recognized adverse-effect religious discrimination from a neutral scheduling rule and required accommodation unless undue hardship was shown.
cases.outcome: The Supreme Court awarded compensation for lost full-time earnings.
cases.what_fr: Une employée adventiste du septième jour a été transférée d’un poste à temps plein à un poste à temps partiel parce qu’elle ne pouvait travailler le samedi.
cases.factors_fr: La Cour a reconnu une discrimination religieuse indirecte découlant d’un horaire neutre et exigé l’accommodement, sauf contrainte excessive.
cases.outcome_fr: La Cour suprême a ordonné une indemnisation pour la perte de revenus du poste à temps plein.
cases.appliesTo: General legal precedent; jurisdiction and facts may differ

cases.title: Sahadeo v. Deputy Head (CBSA)
cases.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
cases.what: Discrimination was alleged in performance assessments and dismissal; several disciplinary penalties and the termination were also grieved.
cases.factors: The Board found inadequate coaching and feedback and bad faith in the termination process, but insufficient evidence linking adverse treatment to race or sex.
cases.outcome: The termination grievance was allowed and reinstatement ordered; several suspension grievances succeeded wholly or partly; discrimination grievance dismissed. Judicial review had been filed (A-78-24).
cases.what_fr: Une employée alléguait de la discrimination dans l’évaluation du rendement et le licenciement et contestait plusieurs suspensions.
cases.factors_fr: La Commission a conclu au manque de mentorat, de rétroaction et à la mauvaise foi dans le licenciement, mais pas de lien suffisamment démontré avec la race ou le sexe.
cases.outcome_fr: Réintégration accordée et plusieurs sanctions annulées ou réduites; grief de discrimination rejeté. Demande de contrôle judiciaire déposée (A-78-24).
cases.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

cases.title: Moniz v. Treasury Board (Global Affairs Canada)
cases.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
cases.what: Travel benefits for a foreign-posted employee and his husband to attend their child's birth through surrogacy were denied.
cases.factors: An added pregnancy-based condition did not appear in the Foreign Service Directive and disproportionately excluded the same-sex couple.
cases.outcome: The grievance was allowed; discriminatory interpretation of the directive established. The Board retained jurisdiction over remedies.
cases.what_fr: Des prestations de déplacement ont été refusées à un employé à l’étranger et à son mari pour la naissance de leur enfant par gestation pour autrui.
cases.factors_fr: Une condition liée à la grossesse, absente de la directive, excluait le couple de même sexe.
cases.outcome_fr: Grief accueilli; interprétation discriminatoire établie. La Commission a conservé sa compétence sur les réparations.
cases.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

cases.title: Schiller v. Canadian Food Inspection Agency
cases.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
cases.what: The employer challenged the Board's power to hear allegations that non-renewal of a term appointment breached a collective agreement's nondiscrimination provisions.
cases.factors: The allegations concerned the collective agreement rather than only a free-standing human-rights claim; the Board found jurisdiction under FPSLRA section 209.
cases.outcome: The employer's jurisdictional objection was dismissed. No merits finding on discrimination was made in this ruling.
cases.what_fr: L’employeur contestait la compétence de la Commission pour examiner la non-reconduction d’un contrat à durée déterminée alléguée discriminatoire.
cases.factors_fr: Le grief invoquait une disposition de non-discrimination de la convention collective, relevant de l’article 209 de la loi.
cases.outcome_fr: Objection de compétence rejetée; aucune conclusion sur le fond de la discrimination dans cette décision.
cases.sourceNote: Interlocutory jurisdiction decision; protected grounds not established in official annual summary.
cases.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

cases.title: Diop v. Treasury Board (Public Works and Government Services)
cases.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
cases.what: A mother challenged repayment of maternity and parental allowances after taking employment at another agency outside specified return-to-work employers.
cases.factors: The Board found the differential treatment turned on which employer received the employee's service, not the protected ground of sex.
cases.outcome: Sex-discrimination grievance dismissed.
cases.what_fr: Une mère contestait le remboursement d’allocations de maternité et parentales après avoir quitté certains employeurs désignés.
cases.factors_fr: La distinction retenue concernait l’employeur de retour, et non un motif protégé fondé sur le sexe.
cases.outcome_fr: Grief de discrimination fondée sur le sexe rejeté.
cases.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

cases.title: McNabb v. Treasury Board (CBSA)
cases.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
cases.what: A permanently disabled border officer was terminated after the CBSA asserted he rejected accommodation offers; family-care leave was also denied.
cases.factors: The employer had not substantiated its claim that accommodation at nearby locations was impossible, did not adequately consult the employee, and treated his questions as a refusal.
cases.outcome: Accommodation, dismissal and leave-related grievances were allowed; remedy phase was separated.
cases.what_fr: Un agent frontalier handicapé de façon permanente a été congédié après des offres d’adaptation contestées; un congé pour soins familiaux a été refusé.
cases.factors_fr: L’employeur n’a pas démontré l’impossibilité d’un accommodement local, a peu consulté l’employé et a traité ses questions comme un refus.
cases.outcome_fr: Griefs accueillis concernant l’adaptation, le licenciement et le congé; réparation examinée séparément.
cases.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

cases.title: Harnois v. Deputy Head (Transport)
cases.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
cases.what: An advertised internal appointment used inconsistent reference checks and an assessment of teamwork challenged as biased.
cases.factors: The Board found a reasonable apprehension of bias, insufficient information and rigid application of flawed instructions.
cases.outcome: Abuse of authority declared. Appointments not revoked; damages question reserved for another hearing.
cases.what_fr: Une nomination interne annoncée comportait des vérifications de références incohérentes et une évaluation du travail d’équipe contestée.
cases.factors_fr: La Commission a constaté une crainte raisonnable de partialité, des renseignements insuffisants et des instructions mal appliquées.
cases.outcome_fr: Abus de pouvoir déclaré. Nominations maintenues; dommages examinés à une autre audience.
cases.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

cases.title: Bolton v. Deputy Head (Department of Justice)
cases.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
cases.what: An employee who had reported harassment was assessed for promotion by a panel influenced by a director general involved in the complaint.
cases.factors: The workplace history, panel members' knowledge of the conflict and the interview context created a reasonable apprehension of bias.
cases.outcome: Staffing complaint allowed; abuse of authority declared and recommendations made; appointment not revoked.
cases.what_fr: Une employée ayant dénoncé du harcèlement a été évaluée par un comité influencé par un directeur général visé par la plainte.
cases.factors_fr: L’historique, la connaissance du conflit et les circonstances de l’entrevue créaient une crainte raisonnable de partialité.
cases.outcome_fr: Plainte de dotation accueillie; abus de pouvoir déclaré et recommandations formulées; nomination maintenue.
cases.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

cases.title: Samson v. Deputy Head (Correctional Service Canada)
cases.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
cases.what: A union local president was marked down in a staffing examination because a manager considered union representation incompatible with impartiality.
cases.factors: The assessor's written comments equated representing members with being partisan, supporting reasonable apprehension of bias.
cases.outcome: Abuse of authority in merit assessment declared; the appointment was not revoked.
cases.what_fr: La présidente locale d’un syndicat a perdu des points dans un concours parce que le gestionnaire associait la représentation syndicale à la partialité.
cases.factors_fr: Les commentaires écrits associaient la représentation des membres à un manque d’impartialité, révélant un risque de partialité.
cases.outcome_fr: Abus de pouvoir déclaré dans l’évaluation du mérite; nomination non révoquée.
cases.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

cases.title: Kline v. Deputy Head (CBSA)
cases.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
cases.what: CBSA dismissed an executive for alleged negligent customs-revenue decisions without a proper investigation.
cases.factors: The alleged negligence and just cause were not proven, and the employer's deficient, delayed process was conducted in bad faith.
cases.outcome: Termination grievance allowed and reinstatement ordered; $35,000 aggravated and $75,000 punitive damages awarded.
cases.what_fr: L’ASFC a licencié une cadre pour négligence alléguée dans la perception de droits sans enquête adéquate.
cases.factors_fr: Ni la négligence ni le motif de licenciement n’étaient prouvés; le processus était tardif et de mauvaise foi.
cases.outcome_fr: Grief accueilli, réintégration et dommages-intérêts aggravés de 35 000 $ et punitifs de 75 000 $.
cases.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

cases.title: Public Service Alliance of Canada v. Canadian Security Intelligence Service
cases.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
cases.what: The bargaining agent challenged delayed collective-agreement ratification and preferential recognition payments for unrepresented staff.
cases.factors: The Board found unexplained delays and failure to share information required for informed bargaining.
cases.outcome: Unfair-labour-practice complaint succeeded on bargaining in good faith; not a finding of racial or disability discrimination.
cases.what_fr: Le syndicat contestait le retard de ratification d’une convention collective et une prime réservée au personnel non syndiqué.
cases.factors_fr: La Commission a relevé des retards injustifiés et un manque d’information pour une négociation éclairée.
cases.outcome_fr: Plainte de pratique déloyale accueillie; pas une conclusion de discrimination raciale ou liée au handicap.
cases.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

cases.title: Mason v. St. Theresa Point First Nation
cases.what: A health authority employee alleged sex-related targeted discipline and termination by a supervisor associated with earlier sexual abuse.
cases.factors: The Tribunal found sex was a factor in disciplinary conduct and dismissal and that the employer recklessly relied on the supervisor's allegations.
cases.outcome: Discrimination established; lost wages, pain-and-suffering and special compensation and public-interest measures ordered.
cases.what_fr: Une employée des services de santé a allégué des mesures disciplinaires ciblées et un congédiement liés au sexe.
cases.factors_fr: Le Tribunal a jugé que le sexe avait contribué aux sanctions et au licenciement, l’employeur ayant suivi les accusations du supérieur sans vérification.
cases.outcome_fr: Discrimination établie; salaires perdus, indemnités et mesures d’intérêt public ordonnés.
cases.appliesTo: Federally regulated employment outside the core public service

cases.title: Starr et al. v. Stevens
cases.what: Three women employed at a band council office reported persistent unwelcome sexual harassment by an elected councillor/manager.
cases.factors: Repeated sexual remarks, gestures and unwanted touching created a poisoned workplace; harm persisted after complaints.
cases.outcome: Harassment established; individual damages for pain and suffering and wilful conduct, training and other orders imposed.
cases.what_fr: Trois femmes d’un conseil de bande ont signalé un harcèlement sexuel persistant commis par un élu et gestionnaire.
cases.factors_fr: Des paroles, gestes et contacts non consentis répétés ont empoisonné le milieu de travail et causé un préjudice.
cases.outcome_fr: Harcèlement établi; indemnités individuelles, formation et autres ordonnances imposées.
cases.appliesTo: Federally regulated employment outside the core public service

cases.title: Karas v. Health Canada
cases.what: A complainant challenged the regulator's role relating to a blood-donation policy affecting gay and bisexual men.
cases.factors: The Tribunal held Health Canada's regulatory oversight was not a CHRA service to this complainant; a regulation cannot be attacked directly through this complaint route.
cases.outcome: Complaint dismissed for jurisdictional reasons; no adjudicated finding that discrimination did or did not occur in employment.
cases.what_fr: Un plaignant contestait le rôle de Santé Canada dans une politique de don de sang.
cases.factors_fr: Le Tribunal a estimé que la surveillance réglementaire ne constituait pas un service au sens de la Loi et qu’un règlement ne pouvait être attaqué directement par ce recours.
cases.outcome_fr: Plainte rejetée pour compétence; aucune conclusion sur une discrimination en emploi.
cases.appliesTo: Not an employee dispute; useful only for a procedural or legal principle

cases.title: Marcovecchio v. Air Canada; Air Canada v. Marcovecchio
cases.body: Canadian Human Rights Tribunal / Federal Court
cases.what: An employee with a hearing-related disability lost a job offer without individualized assessment of his limitations or possible accommodation.
cases.factors: The employer relied on an unsupported assumption that the new role was unsuitable; the Court upheld the Tribunal's fact-based accommodation analysis.
cases.outcome: Discrimination established by the CHRT and upheld on judicial review in 2024 FC 1639.
cases.what_fr: Un employé ayant un handicap auditif a perdu une offre d’emploi sans évaluation individualisée ni recherche d’accommodements.
cases.factors_fr: L’employeur présumait le poste inadapté; la Cour a confirmé l’analyse factuelle du Tribunal.
cases.outcome_fr: Discrimination établie par le Tribunal et confirmée par la Cour fédérale en 2024 CF 1639.
cases.appliesTo: Federally regulated employment outside the core public service

cases.title: McCargar v. Correctional Service Canada
cases.what: An inmate's complaints were dismissed following repeated failure to comply with Tribunal directions.
cases.factors: The Tribunal found case management and disclosure demands became abusive despite opportunities to correct them.
cases.outcome: Proceedings dismissed for abuse of process, not a finding on the merits of alleged discrimination.
cases.what_fr: Des plaintes d’un détenu ont été rejetées après des manquements répétés aux directives du Tribunal.
cases.factors_fr: Les demandes et manquements sont devenus abusifs malgré des occasions de les corriger.
cases.outcome_fr: Plaintes rejetées pour abus de procédure, sans jugement sur le fond de la discrimination alléguée.
cases.appliesTo: Not an employee dispute; useful only for a procedural or legal principle

cases.title: Richards v. Correctional Service Canada
cases.what: An inmate sought additional witnesses concerning alleged systemic discrimination experienced by others.
cases.factors: The proposed accounts were insufficiently connected to the particular complaint and would disproportionally expand the hearing.
cases.outcome: Two witnesses were excluded; discrimination allegations themselves were not decided.
cases.what_fr: Un détenu voulait présenter des témoins concernant la discrimination systémique vécue par d’autres.
cases.factors_fr: Le lien avec sa plainte était insuffisant et ces témoignages auraient allongé l’audience de façon disproportionnée.
cases.outcome_fr: Deux témoins exclus; aucune décision sur le fond de la discrimination.
cases.appliesTo: Not an employee dispute; useful only for a procedural or legal principle

cases.title: Sargeant v. Correctional Service Canada
cases.what: A Black inmate's complaint raised antiracism evidence and broad systemic remedies beyond the original allegations.
cases.factors: The Tribunal limited the case to the referred allegations, permitted relevant contextual evidence, and applied parliamentary privilege to Senate committee material.
cases.outcome: Parts of the pleadings and proposed remedies were struck; race-discrimination liability was not decided.
cases.what_fr: Un détenu noir invoquait des éléments sur le racisme et des réparations systémiques dépassant sa plainte initiale.
cases.factors_fr: Le Tribunal a limité les questions aux allégations renvoyées, accepté le contexte pertinent et appliqué le privilège parlementaire.
cases.outcome_fr: Des éléments des actes et réparations proposés ont été radiés; la discrimination raciale n’a pas été tranchée.
cases.appliesTo: Not an employee dispute; useful only for a procedural or legal principle

cases.title: Liu (on behalf of IPCO) v. Public Safety Canada
cases.what: An organization representing Indigenous police chiefs challenged allegedly discriminatory federal policing-program funding.
cases.factors: The Tribunal required particularized claims (who, when, where and harm), imposed proportional limits on time period and expert witnesses, and rejected certain preliminary objections.
cases.outcome: Interlocutory case management ruling; the underlying systemic discrimination allegation was not established or dismissed.
cases.what_fr: Une organisation de chefs de police autochtones contestait le financement allégué discriminatoire d’un programme fédéral.
cases.factors_fr: Le Tribunal a exigé des précisions sur les personnes, dates, faits et préjudices et limité les preuves et témoins experts.
cases.outcome_fr: Décision procédurale; aucune conclusion sur le fond de la discrimination systémique.
cases.appliesTo: Not an employee dispute; useful only for a procedural or legal principle

cases.title: Richards v. Correctional Service Canada
cases.what: An inmate sought to expand retaliation complaints to introduce different service-discrimination allegations.
cases.factors: The Tribunal held an amendment cannot substitute an unrelated new complaint outside the Commission's referral.
cases.outcome: Amendment refused and retaliation complaints consolidated; no merits finding on retaliation.
cases.what_fr: Un détenu cherchait à transformer des plaintes de représailles en plaintes distinctes de discrimination dans les services.
cases.factors_fr: Une modification ne peut introduire une nouvelle plainte sans lien avec le renvoi de la Commission.
cases.outcome_fr: Modification refusée et plaintes regroupées; fond des représailles non tranché.
cases.appliesTo: Not an employee dispute; useful only for a procedural or legal principle

cases.title: Coalition of First Nation Adults with Disabilities v. Indigenous Services Canada
cases.what: A coalition alleged decades of systemic discrimination against First Nations adults with disabilities in federal services.
cases.factors: The Tribunal required a more specific statement identifying affected persons, harm, periods and the link to protected grounds so the respondent could answer.
cases.outcome: The particulars had to be revised; underlying discrimination was neither proven nor rejected at this stage.
cases.what_fr: Une coalition alléguait des décennies de discrimination systémique contre les adultes des Premières Nations handicapés dans les services fédéraux.
cases.factors_fr: Le Tribunal a demandé plus de précisions sur les personnes, préjudices, périodes et liens avec les motifs protégés.
cases.outcome_fr: Exposé à préciser; aucune conclusion sur le fond de la discrimination.
cases.appliesTo: Not an employee dispute; useful only for a procedural or legal principle

cases.title: Pitawanakwat v. Canada (Attorney General)
cases.body: Federal Court / Canadian Human Rights Tribunal
cases.what: An Indigenous public servant faced racial slurs, stereotyped monitoring, secret management files and loss of employment.
cases.factors: The Tribunal found race-related harassment and workplace discrimination; on review the Court rejected arbitrary restrictions on the compensation analysis.
cases.outcome: Federal Court sent the matter back to reconsider damages; apology, comparable employment and wage-loss relief were among remedies.
cases.what_fr: Une fonctionnaire autochtone a subi des propos racistes, une surveillance stéréotypée, des dossiers secrets et a perdu son emploi.
cases.factors_fr: La preuve appuyait le harcèlement racial et la discrimination; la Cour a rejeté des limites arbitraires de réparation.
cases.outcome_fr: Réexamen des dommages ordonné; excuses, emploi comparable et perte salariale figuraient dans les réparations.
cases.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

cases.title: Grover v. National Research Council of Canada
cases.what: An Indian-born research scientist was blocked from promotion, conferences, funding and development and later lost his position.
cases.factors: The Tribunal found intentional and systemic barriers linked to race and colour, with evidence of witness intimidation and discriminatory career management.
cases.outcome: Orders included cessation, apology, management appointment, wage loss, corrected personnel records and damages under the historic statutory limits.
cases.what_fr: Un chercheur né en Inde s’est vu refuser des promotions, des conférences et du financement avant de perdre son emploi.
cases.factors_fr: Le Tribunal a constaté des obstacles raciaux systématiques et intentionnels et de l’intimidation de témoins.
cases.outcome_fr: Ordonnances de cessation, excuses, poste de gestion, salaires perdus, correction du dossier et indemnisation selon les anciens plafonds.
cases.appliesTo: Federal public-sector or military context; confirm applicable employment statute

cases.title: National Capital Alliance on Race Relations v. Canada (Health Canada)
cases.what: Health Canada employment systems channelled racialized employees into lower-level jobs and limited access to management training and promotion.
cases.factors: The Tribunal considered representation by level, job segregation, subjective appointment practices, training access and biased management assumptions together.
cases.outcome: Systemic discrimination established; ordered equitable promotion practices, training, acting assignments, workforce-based targets and reporting.
cases.what_fr: Les systèmes d’emploi de Santé Canada cantonnaient les employés racisés aux postes subalternes et limitaient leur formation et promotion.
cases.factors_fr: La décision combinait données de représentation, ségrégation des emplois, dotation subjective et accès inégal à la formation.
cases.outcome_fr: Discrimination systémique établie; corrections de dotation, formation, affectations intérimaires, objectifs et reddition de comptes.
cases.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

cases.title: Canada (Attorney General) v. Uzoaba; Uzoaba v. Canada
cases.body: Federal Court / Canadian Human Rights Tribunal
cases.what: CSC management relied on racially motivated inmate complaints to assess and restrict a Black employee's performance and career.
cases.factors: The employer adopted third-party racial prejudice into official workplace decisions, even though inmates themselves were not the employer.
cases.outcome: Court upheld the discrimination finding and higher-level reinstatement remedy; tribunal ordered wage-loss and other relief.
cases.what_fr: La gestion du SCC s’est fondée sur les plaintes racistes de détenus pour évaluer et limiter la carrière d’un employé noir.
cases.factors_fr: L’employeur a repris les préjugés raciaux de tiers dans ses décisions officielles.
cases.outcome_fr: La Cour a confirmé la discrimination et la réintégration à un niveau supérieur, avec indemnités.
cases.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

cases.title: Robichaud v. Canada (Treasury Board)
cases.what: A federal employee complained of sexual harassment by her supervisor and challenged the employer's legal responsibility.
cases.factors: The Court held that the remedial purpose of federal human-rights law requires employer responsibility for discriminatory acts by supervisors in the course of employment.
cases.outcome: Supreme Court allowed the appeal, recognizing employer liability; remedy assessment was a separate question.
cases.what_fr: Une fonctionnaire a dénoncé le harcèlement sexuel de son supérieur et contesté la responsabilité de l’employeur.
cases.factors_fr: La Cour a souligné l’objet réparateur de la loi et la responsabilité de l’employeur pour les actes d’un supérieur dans l’emploi.
cases.outcome_fr: Appel accueilli; responsabilité de l’employeur reconnue, réparation distincte.
cases.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

cases.title: A.B. v. Canada Revenue Agency
cases.body: Federal Public Sector Labour Relations and Employment Board
cases.what: A term CRA employee of Afghan origin and Muslim faith challenged termination after revocation of reliability status following public social-media posts.
cases.factors: The Board examined whether the security decision and dismissal had a nexus to race or religion rather than the employer's documented reliability concerns.
cases.outcome: The racial and religious discrimination grievances were dismissed.
cases.what_fr: Un employé temporaire de l’ARC, né en Afghanistan et musulman, a contesté son licenciement après la révocation de sa cote de fiabilité.
cases.factors_fr: La Commission a examiné si la décision reposait sur la race ou la religion plutôt que sur les motifs de fiabilité documentés.
cases.outcome_fr: Griefs de discrimination raciale et religieuse rejetés.
cases.appliesTo: Direct federal public service case

cases.title: Basi v. Canadian National Railway
cases.what: An Indian-descended candidate was denied an opportunity at CN Rail.
cases.factors: The Tribunal considered inconsistencies in the employer's explanations of interview and selection decisions; discrimination can be inferred from circumstantial evidence.
cases.outcome: Race discrimination established; official CHRC historical summary describes the finding without detailing all remedies.
cases.what_fr: Un candidat d’origine indienne n’a pas obtenu un emploi au CN.
cases.factors_fr: Le Tribunal a examiné les incohérences entre les explications de l’employeur; la preuve indirecte peut établir la discrimination.
cases.outcome_fr: Discrimination raciale établie; le résumé historique officiel ne précise pas toutes les réparations.
cases.appliesTo: Federally regulated employment outside the core public service

cases.title: Gannon v. Canadian Pacific Ltd.
cases.what: A racialized employee was repeatedly racially harassed, unfairly disciplined, and ultimately dismissed.
cases.factors: The Tribunal considered a poisoned environment, the employee's reactive behaviour and the employer's failure to halt racism.
cases.outcome: Racial discrimination established; the parties settled remedies after the Tribunal's finding.
cases.what_fr: Un employé racisé a subi du harcèlement racial répété, des sanctions injustes et un licenciement.
cases.factors_fr: Le Tribunal a tenu compte du milieu empoisonné, de ses réactions aux insultes et de l’inaction de l’employeur.
cases.outcome_fr: Discrimination établie; les parties ont réglé les réparations.
cases.appliesTo: Federally regulated employment outside the core public service

cases.title: Swan v. Canadian Forces
cases.body: Canadian Human Rights Tribunal / Federal Court
cases.what: An Indigenous military member experienced racially discriminatory treatment, comments and harassment.
cases.factors: The Tribunal examined racist treatment and ineffective management response; the Federal Court reversed a limit on lost-wage compensation.
cases.outcome: Discrimination and harassment established, apology and damages ordered, wage-loss question returned and settled; CAF military route differs from civilian FPSLREB.
cases.what_fr: Un militaire autochtone a subi du harcèlement et des traitements discriminatoires raciaux.
cases.factors_fr: Le Tribunal a examiné le harcèlement et la réponse insuffisante; la Cour fédérale a renversé une restriction sur les salaires perdus.
cases.outcome_fr: Discrimination établie, excuses et indemnité; question salariale renvoyée puis réglée. La voie militaire diffère des griefs civils.
cases.appliesTo: Federal public-sector or military context; confirm applicable employment statute

coverage.sourceCoverage: Every case in the reviewed site dataset is included. This is not an exhaustive collection of Canadian tribunal or court decisions.
coverage.excluded: Unpublished decisions, confidential settlements and records not publicly released
coverage.updatePolicy: Manual editorial review required; not a live synchronization of tribunal websites
